method.setup: Two isolated senders explicitly read the respective section and received the same neutral source cases and proposed outbox. Each returned the messages it would send. Two further readers each received one version per case, with the variants alternated and source material, variant labels, and scoring criteria withheld.
method.sender_task: Decide which chat messages go out now. Edit, add, remove, or reroute messages as appropriate. Return the text and recipient for every separate send.
method.recipient_task: For each message, recover the exact action or supported conclusion, its scope and constraints, the check or evidence, and any authority boundary. Identify missing information that would require a lookup or clarification to understand what to do or conclude.
method.scoring: A pass preserves the expected action and authority, scope, acceptance and material evidence. Routine execution and later evidence verification do not count as reconstructing a request. A duplicate send repeats the same assignment or unchanged result without a new obligation. An unnecessary retry to a failed route is counted separately. Words are whitespace-separated tokens in message bodies.
method.requested_model_and_effort: gpt-6.1-terra / low for each sender and reader
method.limitations: One simulated replay per version. The coordinator scored reader outputs against criteria set before the outbox trial. This exercise used explicit reads, no live deliveries, and no instruction-loading or account usage measurements.

pilot.observation: Both independent-review messages named an approval rule without stating its criteria. The first draft was longer. A test-count-only completion control was correctly rejected. The revision added checking the existing send and a preservation test for cutting detail. The next trial used new cases, prior delivery state, and an explicit review criterion.

recipient_readback.catalog: Both readers recovered the grouped paths, retained approvals, and same-candidate check. The base reader also inferred a duty to address the retired override in the test. The candidate reader treated that fact as the reason for grouped admission and assigned only the gate work.
recipient_readback.queue: Both plans left the acknowledged assignment alone.
recipient_readback.reopen: Both recipients recovered that authenticated reopening was still pending, why it stopped, and the exact evidence pointer. Neither assigned a follow-up to the status recipient.
recipient_readback.audit: Both plans reached the authorized replacement and the independent reviewer. The readers recovered the fixture, timeout constraint, same-run report and the exact fresh-versus-expired approval criteria.

outbox_trial.decision: The candidate preserved all four intended sends and their recipient actions in this replay. It was one word shorter than the base for the batch. Both versions eliminated the same duplicate proposals. Treat the role-scope difference as one observed interpretation and retain the wording check. Test real chat traffic before claiming changes in duplicate sends, total costs, or usage.
